research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sinovia Technologies is focused on advancing the manufacturing process of flexible printed OLED displays. Their research includes developing a composite conductive film, which involves a method of layering photoresist material and introducing inorganic particles to its surface. This technique is crucial for enhancing the electrical properties and overall performance of OLED displays. Sinovia's R&D efforts are concentrated on refining the structural components of these displays.

overview_description.description: Sinovia Technologies manufactures flexible printed OLED displays. It uses the same roll-to-roll processes that print labels and packaging to print flexible OLED indicator displays for IoT applications. Its displays are cost-competitive with LED and LCD displays while being thinner, brighter, higher contrast, and lower power.
